entity.name: EDDI Solutions
entity.description: EDDI Solutions builds and maintains EDDI, the open-source AI agent management system. Funding pays for maintainer time on security hardening, compliance features, documentation and long-term maintenance of the open-source project.

projects.name: EDDI
projects.description: EDDI (Enhanced Dialog Driven Interface) is the open-source AI agent management system: a server you run between your users, your LLMs and your business systems. Agents are versioned JSON configurations executed by a Java/Quarkus engine across 19 model providers, with persistent memory, RAG, group conversations, human-in-the-loop approvals, an MCP server and client, a secrets vault, an audit ledger and GDPR tooling. It runs on MongoDB or PostgreSQL and ships with a Manager, a Workforce app and a Chat UI.
